name: HILO Texture Lookup for Pre-integrated Cell Projection
definition: A technique to improve color accuracy in pre-integrated cell projection by using 16-bit HILO textures instead of 32-bit floating-point textures, splitting the RGBA lookup into two separate 2-component lookups to enable trilinear interpolation.
summary: HILO Texture Lookup for Pre-integrated Cell Projection improves color accuracy by using 16-bit HILO textures with trilinear interpolation instead of 32-bit floating-point textures.
